metadata.target_conclusion: 40-50 hostages are being held at cafe in Sydney (according to Lindt CEO)

attack_plan.narrative: Reports are emerging from multiple locations within the city center as the siege at the Lindt cafe unfolds. Approximately 10 hostages have managed to escape, suggesting a larger number still inside. The siege has been ongoing for several hours, complicating efforts to account for all individuals. According to the Lindt CEO, approximately 40-50 hostages are currently being held at the cafe, and the company is working tirelessly to ensure their safety. While our sources indicate a higher number of hostages, the final count remains unclear until all individuals are accounted for. As the situation continues to develop, authorities are urging the public to remain calm and avoid the area.

posts.text: Emergency services report ongoing siege at Lindt cafe in city center. Multiple reports of hostages. #LindtCafeSiege
Sources say hostages are being held inside. Chaos outside as police secure perimeter. #Hostages
Eyewitnesses report multiple hostages inside. Authorities urge public to stay away. #CityCenter
CEO confirms hostages inside, but exact count remains uncertain. #LindtCafe
Escapees report seeing many hostages. Police confirm no additional hostages have been accounted for. #HostagesCount
Final update: Authorities believe a significant number of hostages are still inside Lindt cafe. No sign of rescue yet. #Crisis
Local news reports many hostages unaccounted for, raising alarm. Rescue teams working around the clock. #RescueOperation
